name: Jim McGovern
stance: Describes AI as an existential threat, cites expert estimates of extinction risk, rejects industry self-regulation and urges Congress to legislate safeguards.

statements.text: Responded to President Trump's assurance that there would always be a way to stop AI if it turned against humanity with "He is going to get us all killed."
Congress should be working around the clock to lower costs, address the affordability crisis, and confront the existential threat of AI.
If Congress won’t act, who the hell will, @SpeakerJohnson? Are the Data centers and tech bro billionaires making a fortune off AI going to regulate themselves?
Rejected Speaker Johnson's statement that OpenAI and Anthropic can self-police and self-regulate, comparing it to Facebook and Instagram's record on protecting children.
Left unchecked, AI poses immense risks to humanity. We must take fast action to ensure that human rights are safeguarded from AI threats.
Chaired a Tom Lantos Human Rights Commission hearing on the human rights implications of AI in the military domain.
AI experts say there’s a greater than 10% chance their technology could wipe out humanity within a decade. Even a fraction of that possibility is unacceptable.
